messages:
Maya (CS): Quick weekly check-in for AcmeCorp — noticed a sharp model shift since the canary started 3 days ago. TL;DR: new variant uptake jumped from ~18% to ~62% of requests, p50 latency up ~40ms, fallback rate increased from 0.6% -> 2.7% (spike around 10:00 UTC yesterday). Spend +12% WoW. Snagged a small metric snapshot below for reference.

Maya (CS): ```
period        new_model_uptake  p50_lat_ms  fallback_rate  spend_delta
2026-03-10    18%              210         0.6%           -3%
2026-03-17    62%              250         2.7%           +12%
```

Ben (Solutions): thanks. is the uptake uniform across routes? chat vs batch vs embedding? :eyes:

Maya (CS): Not uniform. Chat routes took most of the new traffic (≈72% of new-model calls). Embeddings stayed pinned to the legacy quantized variant by routing policy. The fallback logs show most failures on long prompt chat sessions (>2k tokens).

Jing (SRE): Checked infra side — no cluster-wide OOMs, but we saw increased KV cache churn on hosts serving the new variant. That aligns with latency blips and a few retries that count as fallbacks.

Priya (DataOps): I sliced fallback by error type: 60% were transient `RESOURCE_BUSY` retries, 25% `MODEL_MISMATCH` (decoder config mismatch during rollout), 15% unknown. Can share raw event ids if needed.

OnboardBot: [automated] CanaryAlert triggered: canary_fallback_rate > 1.5% for last 30m (triggered at 2026-03-17T10:12:04Z).

Alex (AE): Customer reported a "sluggish chat" experience to their PM this morning. Renewal conversation scheduled in two weeks — want to avoid major regressions. Thoughts on short-term mitigations?

Ben (Solutions): short-term: 1) throttle new-variant on high-latency routes, 2) add per-route max_tokens cap, 3) fallback policy tweak to prefer legacy on retry. Example routing snippet to pin chat-critical route: ```
route: /chat/conductive
  policy:
    prefer_model: redwood-legacy-7b
    max_uptake: 20%
```

Maya (CS): Agree with Ben. I'll propose a temporary throttle to Acme and run a 48h sanity. Will also ask them to defer non-critical batch jobs to off-peak.

Jing (SRE): Ops suggests enabling a slightly higher KV cache budget on the nodes serving the new variant and adding a 1s cooldown before retry to reduce transient fallbacks. I'll open infra ticket.

Priya (DataOps): I'll produce a short dashboard (per-route adoption + fallback by error type) and share a link in this thread by EOD.

Maya (CS): Action items: 1) Maya -> propose throttle + messaging to Acme (owner: Maya) 2) Jing -> infra ticket for KV cache budget + retry cooldown (owner: Jing) 3) Priya -> dashboard + raw event dump (owner: Priya) 4) Ben -> prepare routing snippet and rollout rollback playbook (owner: Ben).

Alex (AE): Sounds good. I'll escalate the temporary throttle as a recommended mitigation in the renewal prep deck. :thumbsup:

Ben (Solutions): One more ask — if fallback rate doesn't fall below 1% in 24h, we should consider pausing the canary and reverting to legacy for chat-only traffic.

Maya (CS): noted. I'll update Acme and ping here after throttle goes live. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
